$comment: Shared input/expected vectors for VfLink. The TypeScript rules in link/state.ts and the PHP mirror in packages/razor/src/Support/LinkState.php both run this file. Two rules only: the class list and the rel derivation. There is deliberately no vector for the router branch - which element renders, what `to` becomes, what RouterLink receives - because that branch is Vue's handoff to a component the reference never ships, and a vector for it would be the shared core describing a navigation contract that has no second implementation.

resolveLinkClasses.$why: The underline modifier comes before the tone modifier.

resolveLinkRel.$why: No target and no rel: nothing is written.
The one derivation: _blank without an explicit rel.
An explicit rel wins as given and is not merged with the default.
An explicit rel is written with no target at all.
Nothing is derived for any other target either.
The quirk: an empty-string rel is falsy, so the derivation still applies.
An empty-string rel with no target writes nothing.
